scripts.dev: export GOOGLE_APP_PASSWORD=$(pass show the_moss_concept_website/GOOGLE_APP_PASSWORD) && concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,green" "yarn dev:frontend" "yarn dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: export GOOGLE_APP_PASSWORD=$(pass show the_moss_concept_website/GOOGLE_APP_PASSWORD) && yarn workspace @themossconcept/backend dev
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @themossconcept/frontend lint && yarn workspace @themossconcept/backend lint
scripts.lint:fix: yarn workspace @themossconcept/frontend lint:fix && yarn workspace @themossconcept/backend lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @themossconcept/frontend tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @themossconcept/backend typecheck
